summary: Postinstall and import-time beacon exfiltrates host identifiers to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: The package declares a postinstall hook (`node beacon.cjs`) and a main entry (`index.js`) that both fire a beacon on install and on require(). The beacon collects the installer's OS hostname, install path (`__dirname`), current working directory, and Node version, and POSTs them as JSON over plain HTTP to the hardcoded bare-IP endpoint `http://185.158.107.175:8787/_ah/dc`. `index.js` wraps the import in a try/catch and returns a no-op Proxy so that consuming builds continue silently while still phoning home. The destination is not a publisher-owned endpoint, is not caller-configurable, and the behavior is undocumented to consumers; the dual install-time + import-time trigger ensures the beacon fires even in CI environments that disable lifecycle scripts.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
